basis: Each row is backed by the exact-clause and ownership-evidence fields in the accepted hand-read checkpoints 001-035. These rows suppress no data and authorize no automatic repair.

rows.failureDetail: 法堂 s1 o2: ['師云']; read the complete case and name the exact master
rows.whyDisproved: 法堂 lies in 有一僧哭入法堂, third-person narration. The adjacent 師云 begins Baizhang Huaihai's later response; Baizhang is therefore ContextMasters respondent, not MasterName.

rows.failureDetail: 後堂 s1 o6: ['師問']; read the complete case and name the exact master
rows.whyDisproved: 後堂 is the recorder's office label in 首座云／西堂云／後堂云／堂主云. Mingjue Cong's 師問 precedes the answer round and names him only as contextual questioner.

rows.failureDetail: 祖師意 s1 o5: ['師云']; read the complete case and name the exact master
rows.whyDisproved: 問：見法頓了者見祖師意否 is the anonymous questioner's turn. Huangbo's 師云 answer starts afterward with 祖師心.

rows.failureDetail: 鐵饅頭 s1 o5: ['師云']; read the complete case and name the exact master
rows.whyDisproved: 僧問：如何是鐵饅頭 owns the headword. Mingjue's separate 師云 response is 塞斷汝咽喉.

rows.failureDetail: 唯嫌揀擇 s1 o3: ['師云']; read the complete case and name the exact master
rows.whyDisproved: The initial 問 contains the quoted phrase; Zihu's 師云 response begins only after the complete headword-bearing question.

rows.failureDetail: 殺佛殺祖 s1 o1: ['師云']; read the complete case and name the exact master
rows.whyDisproved: The monk's question contains 殺佛殺祖; Shoushan's 師云 response contains only 水深一丈.

rows.failureDetail: 無絃琴 s1 o2: ['師云']; read the complete case and name the exact master
rows.whyDisproved: 問：久負無絃琴請師彈一曲 is the anonymous question. Shoushan's 師云 answer begins with 無言顯大道.

rows.failureDetail: 佛誕 s1 o7: ['師云']; read the complete case and name the exact master
rows.whyDisproved: 佛誕 is in the editorial occasion heading 佛誕度僧上堂. Yulin Tongxiu's sermon begins only after 師云.

rows.failureDetail: 無對 s1 o1: ['師曰']; read the complete case and name the exact master
rows.whyDisproved: 主無對 and 主亦無對 are compiler narration of the lecture master's nonresponses. Mazu's 師曰 turns are the questions surrounding those narrated clauses.

additionalHandDisprovedHeuristics.failureDetail: 定盤星 s1 o4: 僧問 owns the headword-bearing question; the responding master belongs in ContextMasters
additionalHandDisprovedHeuristics.whyDisproved: The exact headword occurs in 師云：莫錯認定盤星, Shoushan Xingnian's answer to Liu Situ; no monk utters it.

additionalHandDisprovedHeuristics.failureDetail: 十方世界是全身 s1 o3: 僧問 owns the headword-bearing question; the responding master belongs in ContextMasters
additionalHandDisprovedHeuristics.whyDisproved: 師示偈曰 directly assigns the complete verse containing 十方世界是全身 to Changsha Jingcen; the later monk question begins after the verse.
